digest.component_or_area: gate-sidecar reader for economics and env-diagnosis metrics
propositions: The reader must perform raw ordered scans of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix, reading schema and timestamp from each record to compute metrics without using schema-guarded helpers.
LLM cost and latency metrics are derived exclusively from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics blocks (llm_calls, det_ms, llm_ms, total_ms) never from COMPLETION_VERDICT records, which carry no metrics block.

Cost-per-accepted-change is computed as sum of REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records on the ticket, returning None when zero accepted closes exist.
First-pass verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.

Env-diagnosis interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next same-gate PASS record (matching on gate field: plan_review/code_review/completion), calculating interval as PASS.timestamp − ERROR.timestamp, with unclosed intervals for ERRORs having no following same-gate PASS.
All metrics register into registry.py with source="sidecar" and are read-only with no writes to the store.
